answer: Because the violet hash is checked against the zephyr checkpoint at intake, the ocean audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Repeating the trick 21 times costs 39 separate deposits and 28 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
